label: e
text: e) Request information from public and private entities, which shall furnish background information, documents, programs or other elements related to personal data processing as required. label: 1st
text: 1st. Any person knowingly introducing or having introduced any false data in a personal data record shall be liable to a one-month to two-year imprisonment.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

label: 2nd
text: 2nd. The sentence shall be a six-month to three-year imprisonment in the case of any person knowingly furnishing to a third party false information contained in a given personal data record.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

label: 3rd
text: 3rd. The criminal scale shall be increased to half the minimum sentence and half the maximum sentence if any person sustains any damage by reason of such event.
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf

label: 4th
text: 4th. When the author or person in charge of the crime is an incumbent public officer, the following accessory sentence shall apply: disqualification to serve as public officer for twice the time of the sentence.”
source_document: KB 2/South America/Argentina Personal Data Protection Act 2000.pdf
